summary_en: Mammy Mart HD raised FY2026 (ending September 2026) year-end dividend guidance from 11.20 yen to 12.10 yen per share, bringing total annual dividend to 22.10 yen including 10.00 yen interim dividend. The increase reflects stronger full-year performance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Mammy Mart HD announced an upward revision to its FY2026 (fiscal year ending September 2026) year-end dividend forecast on November 13, 2026. The company raised the year-end dividend from the previously announced 11.20 yen per share to 12.10 yen per share, an increase of 0.90 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 10.00 yen paid in the second quarter, the revised total annual dividend is now 22.10 yen per share, compared to the prior forecast of 21.20 yen.

The company cited stronger-than-expected full-year operating performance disclosed in today's earnings announcement (Earnings Release under Japanese GAAP) as the primary reason for the upward revision. The revision reflects the company's policy of maintaining a consolidated dividend payout ratio of approximately 20% while balancing shareholder returns with capital needs. The company continues to prioritize profit distribution and stable dividend payments as core management policies.

The decision also takes into account the company's ongoing capital investment requirements for store expansion, store renovations to enhance competitiveness in the intensifying retail environment, information technology investments, and business infrastructure strengthening. The dividend increase demonstrates the company's confidence in its operational trajectory while maintaining financial discipline across business growth initiatives.
